title: Beefy vaults on HyperEVM
tagline: Every vault, reward pool and CLM manager the three Beefy factories on HyperEVM have created, with their share-token transfers, deposits and withdrawals, discovered from the factories and indexed from the block each was created. Block times are not stored in this nest, so use block numbers.

queries.title: Latest CLM share transfers
queries.sql: SELECT block_number, address, "from", "to", value_dec FROM clm_manager__transfer ORDER BY block_number DESC, log_index DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Contracts the factories created
queries.sql: SELECT 'classic_vault' AS kind, count(*) AS contracts FROM classic_vault_factory__proxy_created UNION ALL SELECT 'clm_manager', count(*) FROM clm_manager_factory__proxy_created

queries.title: Most active CLM managers by deposits
queries.sql: SELECT address AS clm_manager, count(*) AS deposits FROM clm_manager__deposit GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY deposits DESC LIMIT 10

queries.title: Deposits and withdrawals per CLM manager
queries.sql: SELECT d.address AS clm_manager, d.n AS deposits, coalesce(w.n, 0) AS withdrawals FROM (SELECT address, count(*) AS n FROM clm_manager__deposit GROUP BY 1) d LEFT JOIN (SELECT address, count(*) AS n FROM clm_manager__withdraw GROUP BY 1) w ON d.address = w.address ORDER BY d.n DESC LIMIT 10

queries.title: Reward pool stakers
queries.sql: SELECT address AS reward_pool, count(*) AS stake_events FROM reward_pool__staked GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY stake_events DESC LIMIT 10

prompts: How many classic vaults and CLM managers have the Beefy factories created on HyperEVM? Use tables classic_vault_factory__proxy_created and clm_manager_factory__proxy_created.
Which 10 CLM managers have the most deposits (table clm_manager__deposit), and how many withdrawals (clm_manager__withdraw) does each have?
Which reward pools have the most stake events (table reward_pool__staked)? Show the top 10 with their counts.
Show the 20 most recent share transfers across all CLM managers (table clm_manager__transfer) with block number, from, to and amount.
List every table in this nest with its row count, then say in two sentences what the data is good for.
